- **Binance archive `https://data.binance.vision/` — the recorded reading "HTTP 200 (static front page only; `/data/` returns 404; no traversable usable datasets)" is WRONG and is superseded.** Concrete dated objects are public, keyless and readable: `data/futures/um/daily/klines/BTCUSDT/1d/BTCUSDT-1d-2024-01-01.zip` (200, 353 B), `data/futures/um/daily/premiumIndexKlines/BTCUSDT/1d/BTCUSDT-1d-2024-01-01.zip` (200, 326 B), `data/futures/um/daily/metrics/BTCUSDT/BTCUSDT-metrics-2024-01-01.zip` (200, 11,521 B), `data/futures/um/monthly/fundingRate/BTCUSDT/BTCUSDT-fundingRate-2024-01.zip` (200, 696 B), `data/spot/daily/klines/BTCUSDT/1d/BTCUSDT-1d-2024-01-01.zip` (200, 240 B), `data/futures/cm/daily/liquidationSnapshot/BTCUSD_PERP/BTCUSD_PERP-liquidationSnapshot-2024-01-01.zip` (200, 2,188 B). Payloads verified: UM klines carry the 12-field OHLCV schema; UM metrics carry `create_time,symbol,sum_open_interest,sum_open_interest_value` plus long/short ratios at 5-minute cadence (289 rows for 2024-01-01); funding carries `calc_time,funding_interval_hours,last_funding_rate`; the liquidation file carries the 10-field per-event schema (`time,side,order_type,time_in_force,original_quantity,price,average_price,order_status,last_fill_quantity,accumulated_fill_quantity`).
- **Traversal is available through the S3 ListObjectsV2 API, not through the website path.** `https://s3-ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com/data.binance.vision?list-type=2&prefix=data/&delimiter=/` returns the prefixes `data/futures/`, `data/option/`, `data/spot/`; the root listing returns 17 keys. The website path `/data/` returns 404 because no object exists at that key — a property of the path, not of the data. The prior cycles' conclusion was drawn from the 404 alone.
- **Currency re-verified to 2026-11-10** (HTTP 200): UM daily klines, UM premium-index 1-day klines, UM 5-minute metrics, CM 5-minute metrics and spot daily klines. The archive's futures and spot trees are current to the last complete UTC day; they are not a historical-only product.

**Per-entry consequences.**
- **(1) CRYPTO-EDGE-001 — basis/carry reversal.** Basis, mark price, funding and open interest are free and current to 2026-11-10 on the archive, so the registered **open-interest-clearing** fallback tail statistic is computable over the post-July-2024 regime on free data. The per-event forced-liquidation flow remains bounded, and its bound is now exact: the relocated linear prefix `data3/liquidationSnapshot/BTCUSDT/` enumerates to **562 objects = 281 daily zips + 281 `.CHECKSUM` sidecars**, dates **2023-06-25 to 2024-03-31**, all `LastModified` 2025-04-16T06:43:44–49Z, 6,427,695 bytes total; the COIN-M per-event record still ends 2024-10-14 (last object 200). The entry's "single largest unknown" — the primary (linear) arm's per-event effective sample — is therefore **bounded at 281 days ending 2024-03-31 and unmeasurable beyond that on the free native archive.** One new fact: OKX publishes a free per-event, side-attributed liquidation record on a USDT-margined perpetual (`BTC-USDT-SWAP`) plus dated funding history, which post-dates the archive's discontinuation and covers the post-July-2024 regime **going forward only**; its retrospective depth was not enumerated this cycle and is the next cycle's task.
